dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetric 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant localized bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium slate grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, light-toned longitudinal linear marks (rake marks) scattered across the mid-dorsal and right lateral surfaces.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct, shadowed linear groove or indentation following the central longitudinal axis on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Longitudinal linear scarring/rake marks are visible on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, high-contrast circular aperture representing the blowhole is visible at the anterior end of the dorsal plane.
